value.rationale: A synchronized resetting disturbance induces a non-binomial finite habitat occupancy count distribution. Exactly how the most likely occupied-site count changes as catastrophe frequency rises is a natural and motivated population-ecology question. The sharp all-N mode classification and strictly ordered, finite threshold staircase give complete regime information distinct from mean occupancy.
